prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: API 错误码排查对照表 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 4 columns × 8 rows. Row headers: yes (first logical column identifies each row).
Per-column content facts (content px at 15px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "错误码" · longest unbreakable word 49px · one-line width 49px
  col 2: header "错误信息" · longest unbreakable word 154px · one-line width 154px
  col 3: header "含义" · longest unbreakable word 95px · one-line width 740px
  col 4: header "解决办法" · longest unbreakable word 110px · one-line width 1964px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 720px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 719px.
Fixed: content, font, 15px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"帮助开发者根据 API 错误码和错误信息定位原因，并查找对应的解决办法。","reading":"读者通常先扫描错误码或错误信息找到目标行，再横向阅读含义和解决办法；比较多个错误时，需要保持每行的对应关系清晰。","groups":["错误码与错误信息共同标识错误，适合保持紧凑并便于快速扫描。","含义与解决办法共同构成排查内容：前者解释原因，后者指导操作，应获得大部分宽度。"],"keep_intact":["错误码数字","INVALID_APPID、INVALID_CREDENTIAL 等错误信息标识符","AppID、access_token、AppSecret、OpenID 等技术标识符"],"may_wrap":["含义中的中文解释可按自然语义换行。","解决办法中的中文步骤和说明可换行；较长的解决办法通常决定行高，其他列的换行可利用这部分行高。"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r1A: widths [70, 175, 155, 319] · table 720×1244px · row heights [36, 153, 176, 176, 176, 176, 176, 176] · column headers wrapped 0/4 · tallest cell 7 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r1B: widths [70, 175, 170, 304] · table 720×1314px · row heights [36, 176, 199, 176, 176, 176, 176, 199] · column headers wrapped 0/4 · tallest cell 8 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r1C: widths [70, 175, 145, 329] · table 720×1175px · row heights [36, 153, 176, 153, 153, 176, 153, 176] · column headers wrapped 0/4 · tallest cell 7 lines · mid-word splits 0

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r1A","good":"错误码和错误信息完整且易于扫描；含义与解决办法各自成栏，行对应关系清楚。","problems":"含义列的中文解释较碎，解决办法仍有较多换行；多个长行使标识列留下大片空白。","cause":"155px 的含义列有效文字宽度仅 134px；319px 的解决办法列承载了明显更多的文字，主要决定行高。"},{"design":"r1B","good":"170px 的含义列让原因解释较舒展，标识符和表头保持完整。","problems":"解决办法更拥挤，部分行达到八行，表格更长，标识列的空白也更明显；含义列增加的宽度对横向查阅的收益有限。","cause":"相比 r1A，含义列增加 15px，而文字量最大的解决办法列缩至 304px，导致多行额外换行。"},{"design":"r1C","good":"解决办法较宽，多行比其他方案更紧凑；错误标识完整，行边界清晰，整体是三个方案中最均衡的。","problems":"含义列的短行较多，个别句尾只剩少数字符，例如第二行的“效。”；解决办法仍较密集，值得继续寻找更好的宽度平衡。","cause":"145px 的含义列有效文字宽度为 124px；329px 的解决办法列虽有改善，仍须容纳大量中文和技术标识符。"}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"C微调","widths":[70,175,150,324],"change":"在 r1C 基础上给含义列增加 5px，观察能否减少零碎句尾，同时尽量保留解决办法的宽度优势。"},{"name":"操作优先","widths":[70,175,135,339],"change":"将 10px 从含义列移给解决办法，检验更宽的操作说明能否改善整体阅读节奏，以及含义列是否仍足够易读。"},{"name":"含义底线","widths":[70,175,116,358],"change":"让含义列保留恰好容纳最长不可拆分内容的宽度，把更多空间交给解决办法；检验极限分配下含义是否过于破碎。"}]}
